options.label: HTML Presentation (Recommended)
options.description: Web-based slides, open in any browser. Press T to cycle 36 themes, A to preview animations, F for fullscreen. Best for quick previews and social media sharing.

options.label: PowerPoint File (.pptx)
options.description: Native .pptx format, editable in PowerPoint/Keynote. Best for formal reports, printing, and enterprise scenarios. All parameters are locked after generation.
